summary: Nutrien Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 6, 2026, reporting a news release dated August 5, 2026, announcing that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of US$0.55 per share. The dividend is payable on October 16, 2026, to shareholders of record on September 29, 2026. Canadian-resident registered shareholders and beneficial holders through CDS will receive payment in Canadian dollars, while U.S.-dollar payments go to others, with currency election options available via Computershare. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions are involved.
